text:
Maya Ramos: kicking off intake for the new parametric-LM v0.9 bring-up — need to pick a quant strategy (int8 vs fp8 vs gguf hybrid) and a calibration plan. can we shortlist experiments this week?
Jordan Lee: +1. I can run calibration sweeps. what's the primary metric — LPIPS? latency? or generation-quality (exact-match / rouge)?
Maya Ramos: priority order: 1) generation quality on our regen-suite, 2) 99p latency for short prompts (<128 tokens), 3) cost reduction target ~2-3x. quality trumps cost if regression >1.5% on key prompts.
Sam B: for cost/capacity modelling I want both batch and single-token latency numbers. can we record tail-latency and tokens/sec for each config?
Maya Ramos: yes. include: p50/p95/p99 latency, tokens/sec, vram peak, and eval-quality (exact-match, avg-logprob, hallucination-rate).
Jordan Lee: plan suggestion: run three branches in parallel:
1) int8 per-channel (baseline) — full-range calibration using our 10k prompt calibration set
2) fp8 mixed (blockwise) — no calibration, measure immediate accuracy drop
3) gguf-8 hybrid (activation quant + float weights) — run light calibration and KV-cache checks
Jordan Lee: command to start int8 sweep:```bash
./quantize_tool --model=parametric-v0.9.bin --mode=int8 --calib-set=data/calib_10k.json --out=work/int8/
```
Maya Ramos: good. @Jordan can you attach the calibration seed and config when you kick off? also add the eval subset focused on long-form reasoning (prompt family C).
Jordan Lee: will do. seeding config: `--seed 42 --per-channel` and I'll snapshot `calib_stats/*.npy`.
Anya Patel: small ask — add the hallucination-sensitive tests from the regression bucket (ids: reg-17, reg-21, reg-33). if int8 causes content drift we should detect it early.
Sam B: on prioritization: if int8 meets quality within 0.8% and reduces cost >2x then upgrade priority to fast-path. otherwise, fp8 hybrid gets staged rollout.
Maya Ramos: timeline: Jordan starts calibration today, Sam runs perf-side tomorrow, Anya runs regression suite after calibration completes. if we see any >1% regressions, block canary.
Jordan Lee: kicked off int8 calibration job: job id q-1790256790. attaching initial logs:```
[INFO] loading model parametric-v0.9.bin
[INFO] calib samples loaded: 10000
[INFO] running per-channel min/max collection
```
inference-bot: job q-1790256790 started on runner-gpu-12 (p3x2). expected ETA ~45m. :rocket:
Anya Patel: noted. I'll prepare prompt family C subset and hallucination markers. uploading to /datasets/evals/parametric/v0.9/ by EOD.
Sam B: I'll run synthetic latency sweep once Jordan posts tokens/sec. planning batches: [1,4,8,16], seq-lens [32,128,512].
Maya Ramos: checklist for this intake: 
- [ ] run int8 per-channel calibration + eval set
- [ ] run fp8 mixed experiment (no calib)
- [ ] run gguf-8 hybrid with light calib
- [ ] collect p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, vram
- [ ] run regression buckets (reg-17/21/33 + reasoning subset)
- [ ] decide rollout policy (canary thresholds)

Maya Ramos: tagging outcomes: if quality regression <=0.8% and p99 < 250ms for short prompts -> canary on Dedicated; if regression >1.5% -> rollback and try gguf hybrid. any objections?
Jordan Lee: no objections. will post q-logs and final metric table when done.
Anya Patel: fine by me. will also add prompts that previously flagged sensitivity to quant noise.
Sam B: ok, I'll queue perf runs and sync results in the thread. :thumbsup:
Maya Ramos: thanks all — please update thread when your job ends. keeping this scoped to a single PR for the model-onboard repo.
inference-bot: job q-1790256790 completed (exit 0). artifacts: s3://redwood-experiments/parametric/v0.9/int8/calib_stats.tgz, metrics CSV uploaded.
